releases.notes:
### New
- **Data packs for new worlds.** On the Create World screen, open the **More** tab and click **Vanilla Tweaks Data Packs...**. A separate window lists Vanilla Tweaks **data packs** and **crafting tweaks**; pick some, click **Add to World**, then **Done**, and they're switched on for that world. They stay apart from your resource packs.
- **Download Mods.** When a pack needs a mod you don't have, the warning can now download the mod's Fabric version (plus any mods it needs) into your mods folder. They work once you restart Minecraft.
- **Switch On** (on by default). Packs you download come back switched on, so clicking Done in TweakSwitch applies them. Turn it off in the downloader if you'd rather choose yourself.
- **Saved pictures.** Icons, previews and animations are kept on disk for a week, so screens fill in straight away and work offline.

### Fixed
- Hovering a pack you already downloaded now shows its preview.
- The TweakSwitch button no longer appears on the Data Packs screen.

### Which jar do I need?
| Your Minecraft | Download |
|---|---|
| 1.21.9 or 1.21.10 | `tweakswitch-1.4.0+1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | `tweakswitch-1.4.0+1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1, 26.1.1 or 26.1.2 | `tweakswitch-1.4.0+26.1.jar` |
| 26.2 | `tweakswitch-1.4.0+26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `tweakswitch-1.4.0+26.3.jar` |

### Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for your Minecraft version (0.19.5 or newer).
2. Put the matching TweakSwitch jar (below) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for your version in `.minecraft/mods`, replacing any older TweakSwitch jar. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional.
3. In-game, press **K**.

The Vanilla Tweaks downloader is used with permission from Vanilla Tweaks.

3. In-game, press **K**.

releases.notes:
Easier to manage lots of packs, sharper previews, and a smaller UI. For **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric).

### New
- **Tabs:** your own packs (**Imported**), **Vanilla Tweaks** downloads and **Modrinth** downloads each have their own tab, with counts
- **Shift previews:** tap **Shift** to turn the hover preview panel on or off, on the TweakSwitch, Vanilla Tweaks and Modrinth screens
- **See what any pack does:** packs without a website show the textures inside them, plus a summary like "Changes: Particles (12)". Particle definitions are followed to their textures, even when those live in another pack or the game itself
- **Group your switches** by Category (Vanilla Tweaks), by what they change (with sub-groups like "Particles · Dripping"), by On/Off, or A–Z
- **Whole-group switch** on each group header turns every pack in it on or off
- **Search inside packs:** file names count, so "flame" finds a pack that changes the flame particle
- **Texture icons** for packs that share one logo or have none

### Improved
- **Sharper previews:** pictures are decoded at the size they're shown and scaled smoothly; Modrinth uses full-size gallery pictures
- **Smaller UI:** one-row header, shorter buttons, compact cards and tiles; header centered on wide screens
- Download buttons are now **+ Vanilla Tweaks** and **+ Modrinth**

### Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft 26.3 (0.19.5 or newer).
2. Put `tweakswitch-1.2.0.jar` (below) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 in your `.minecraft/mods` folder, replacing any older TweakSwitch jar. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional.
3. In-game, press **K**.

releases.notes:
Fixes **"Incompatible mods found"** on Fabric Loader 0.19.5.

TweakSwitch asked for Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, which it never actually needed. It now works with **0.19.5 or newer**, like the other popular 26.3 mods. Nothing else changed from 1.1.0.

### Install
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft 26.3 (0.19.5 or newer).
2. Put `tweakswitch-1.1.1.jar` (below) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 in your `.minecraft/mods` folder, replacing any older TweakSwitch jar. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional.
3. In-game, press **K**.
